crossRefs.note: He would not allow anyone to carry a container through the temple.

translations.web: He would not allow anyone to carry a container through the temple.
translations.bsb: And He would not allow anyone to carry merchandise through the temple courts.
translations.kjv: And would not suffer that any man should carry any vessel through the temple.
translations.asv: and he would not suffer that any man should carry a vessel through the temple.
